name: Buffalo County, NE
findings: Buffalo County has 171 nonprofit organizations. 88 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 67 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Buffalo County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 22 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 10 in similar places of this size.
